prompt: Which query returns, for every store located in Belgium (country_code BE) and every calendar day from 26 February to 3 March 2025, the number of orders the store got that day (the UTC date of order_ts), with 0 when it had none? One row per store and day. Any row order is fine.

options.text:
WITH day_orders AS (SELECT store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS order_day, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders GROUP BY store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE))
SELECT st.store_code, cal.cal_date, COALESCE(d.n_orders, 0) AS n_orders
FROM stores st
CROSS JOIN calendar cal
JOIN day_orders d ON d.store_id = st.store_id AND d.order_day = cal.cal_date
WHERE st.country_code = 'BE' AND cal.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-26' AND DATE '2025-03-03'

WITH day_orders AS (SELECT store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS order_day, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders GROUP BY store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE))
SELECT st.store_code, cal.cal_date, d.n_orders
FROM stores st
CROSS JOIN calendar cal
LEFT JOIN day_orders d ON d.store_id = st.store_id AND d.order_day = cal.cal_date
WHERE st.country_code = 'BE' AND cal.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-26' AND DATE '2025-03-03'

WITH day_orders AS (SELECT store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE) AS order_day, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM orders GROUP BY store_id, CAST(order_ts AS DATE))
SELECT st.store_code, cal.cal_date, COALESCE(d.n_orders, 0) AS n_orders
FROM stores st
CROSS JOIN calendar cal
LEFT JOIN day_orders d ON d.store_id = st.store_id AND d.order_day = cal.cal_date
WHERE st.country_code = 'BE' AND cal.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-26' AND DATE '2025-03-03'

SELECT st.store_code, cal.cal_date, COUNT(*) AS n_orders
FROM stores st
CROSS JOIN calendar cal
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = st.store_id AND CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) = cal.cal_date
WHERE st.country_code = 'BE' AND cal.cal_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-26' AND DATE '2025-03-03'
GROUP BY st.store_code, cal.cal_date
